content_text:
On days where you can allocate less budget/ time to lighting, what have you found helps you make the day work with the tools at your disposal?
For example are you pushing more for a pre light to make sure a smaller base package gets the job done? Or do you keep a minimum package with you on every location that you’re comfortable working with?
